meta.description: ORVIBO Smart Lock S2: black-and-gold armor from an iF Gold Award-winning team, a smart cylinder that checks every unlock a second time, 8 sensors, up to 800 days on one set of batteries, six ways to unlock and a Wi-Fi connection in 0.8 s.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO Smart Lock S2 specifications: fits over 95% of standard doors with no new holes, 337 × 67 × 71.3 mm panels, 7.5 V from 10 AA batteries, 25 users, six ways to unlock, smart alerts and a USB-C emergency power port.

sec1.title: Black-and-gold armor. Tough and fearless.
sec2_1.title: Tempered black armor

sec2.title: Solid armor-gold handle
sec2.subDesc: Plated in real gold, with armor-inspired details and subtle edges
sec3.title:
The smart cylinder:
where premium begins
sec3.subDesc: The key to choosing a better smart fingerprint lock is the cylinder. The S2 uses an electromechanical Auto smart cylinder that protects your home from the inside out. A good cylinder is the core of security.
sec4.title: Dual-core operation, double the security
sec4.subDesc: Most locks go straight from the identity check to releasing the clutch. The S2 adds a separate motor inside the cylinder that checks the unlock data again, for double protection.
sec5.title: 8 built-in sensors: a guard that “thinks”
sec5.subDesc: For all-round protection, the S2 carries 8 sensors inside and out. It reads the lock’s state precisely, reports anything unusual at once and watches your door around the clock.
sec6.title: Spots trouble and responds in an instant
sec7.title: New-generation ULPC™ technology adds a full year of battery life
sec7.subDesc: The new generation of Ultra Low Power Consumption™ does more with less power, and a larger battery compartment ends the industry’s 18-month battery change: the lock runs for up to two and a half years. If anything gives out first, it will be the batteries, not the lock.
sec8.title:
Grade C copper cylinder,
bank-level protection
sec8.subDesc: A German-style, drill-resistant Grade C solid copper cylinder with a built-in key sensor, paired with an austenitic 304 stainless steel lock body, resists brute force and prying like a bank lock.
sec9.title: Encrypted main processor: fingerprint unlocking that’s safe and fast
sec9.subDesc: Mature semiconductor fingerprint recognition, a Swedish FPC fingerprint chip, a new AI algorithm from 2020 and asymmetric encrypted communication hold the lock’s first line of defense.
sec9.info2: Stops fake fingerprints and orange-peel tricks
sec10.title: 6 ways to unlock, for the whole family
sec11_1.title: Online in 0.8 s, so fast it doesn’t feel like a Wi-Fi lock
sec11_1.subDesc: Wi-Fi lock = slow? Not anymore. The S2’s upgraded Wi-Fi networking wakes and connects within 0.8 s to send and receive data.
sec11.title: Linked to your home and appliances: the lock is your scene switch
sec11.subDesc: Once it’s online, set up the scenes you want in the ORVIBO Home app: lights on and curtains open when you come in, lights and AC off when you leave.
sec13.title: Passed 50+ professional quality tests
sec13.subtitle: Lock spring life test
sec13.info: * Data from the ORVIBO lock lab: the S2’s test reports on its lock body, bolt components, motor and operating environment, among others.
param1.title: Fits almost any standard door and installs with no new holes
param1.subDesc: The standard 6068 format fits over 95% of standard-size wooden and security doors. A standard 23.5 cm hole spacing lets you upgrade a traditional lock without drilling new holes, and redesigned internal wiring joins the inside and outside units with a single cable for easy installation.
param2.title: Free home installation nationwide and attentive after-sales service
